evidence: Removes process-global index instances across src/index/ and transfers ownership to NodeContext.
rationale: Transfers ownership of secondary indexes from global singletons into NodeContext, improving encapsulation and test isolation. As noted in the description, removing global singletons like '`g_txindex`' and '`g_coin_stats_index`' decouples index lifecycle from process-wide state, but does not alter index data integrity, sync performance, or correctness.
